items.title: Ida Goodson Interview, 1961-05-06
items.q: Who else was in Mack's band? ... Oh, he had two boys, one named Leach, the Leach Brothers.

ctx.x: Bass killer. Who else was in Mack's band?
Oh, he had two boys, one named Leach, the Leach Brothers. He was from, uh, Taylor Eleanor. From Eleanor. And, um, one plays sax. Don't get on the... One big trumpet. Sammy, don't get on the choir.
